pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in Luxembourg: 42.9% in 2023 and 46.5% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); all plastics together, no separate figure for PET bottles
